facts.fact: PM-KISAN helpline 155261 is a 24x7 IVRS helpline for checking beneficiary status (PIB, 14 Mar 2023)
facts.quote: Further, farmers can check their beneficiary status through a 24x7 IVRS based helpline 155261.

facts.fact: PIB's press-conference note of 24 Feb 2020 gives toll-free 1800-11-5526 or 155261 to check application status
facts.quote: 24x7 IVRS based help line launched for status verification. Farmers can dial 1800-11-5526 or 155261 to know the status of their application.
facts.note: Not checked whether 1800-11-5526 is still active in 2026; no newer official page gives it.

28 Oct 2026: not in the text or HTML of pmkisan.gov.in (home, Contacts, Grievance) nor on any fetched PIB page; only blogs/news (housing.com, krishijagran etc.) give it. The expected answer already called it unconfirmed.

facts.fact: The pmkisan.gov.in Help-Desk is the online Grievance Query Form (Raise Grievance / Check Status using the Registration Number)
facts.quote: Grievance Query Form Know Your Registration Number Back Raise Grievance Check Status Temporary / Registration Number

facts.fact: The portal points farmers to the Kisan eMitra chatbot
facts.quote: Farmers are requested to check their eligibility status on Know Your Status (KYS) of PM KISAN website/ mobile app or Kisan eMitra chatbot for further details.

behaviour: Gives 155261 (the 24x7 IVRS helpline for beneficiary/application status) and 1800-11-5526 with citation to PIB; points to the pmkisan.gov.in Help-Desk / Grievance Query Form for complaints and may mention the Kisan eMitra chatbot; must not claim pmkisan.gov.in lists these numbers; must not invent other numbers.
fail_if: It gives the Kisan Call Centre number 1800-180-1551 as the PM-Kisan helpline; gives 011-23381092, 011-24300606 or another number no official page confirms as current; cites a pmkisan.gov.in page as showing the number; cites blogs (Paisabazaar etc.).
summary: 155261 (PIB 2023) and 1800-11-5526 (PIB 2020) confirmed, portal Help-Desk/Grievance form and Kisan eMitra confirmed; 011-24300606 still on no official page, so it is dropped.
